manual:
Publishes the normal-network topology (every server your scripts have discovered, not the hidden darknet) plus your current city and connected host, refreshed continuously with no Singularity dependency at all - Known Servers, Rooted, Backdoored, and the map itself all stay live even with zero Source Files owned. Formulas Score controls whether node coloring/ranking uses precise Formulas.exe-based XP-per-second scoring or a rougher heuristic fallback when Formulas.exe isn't owned.

Actually connecting, traveling between cities, or opening a company location straight from the map all need Singularity access - deliberately isolated on its own worker and port (separate from the always-on base scanner) so the free topology-scanning half never pays for that RAM up front. Without Singularity, the map still shows you the way; it just can't walk it for you - Singularity Access reports whether it currently can.
